source.document: The strictest standard limit of JLCPCB, PCBWay, OSH Park and Eurocircuits
source.notes: Rigid FR-4, 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer copper, 1, 2, 4 or 6 copper layers: one set of limits for a board not yet ordered anywhere. Each rule takes the strictest of the standard values that JLCPCB (recommended values, no surcharge), PCBWay (normal values, no surcharge), OSH Park and Eurocircuits (pattern class 6) publish, over the layer counts covered, and names the row that decides and what the others say. A rule none of them publishes is not checked. Rules marked as the author's choice are defaults, not limits. It has no options: the mask web is the one for the widest-web colours, and heavier outer copper is not covered (JLCPCB and Eurocircuits ask wider tracks and spacing at 2 oz; nothing checks the copper weight of the board). Other fabricators can ask more: AISLER's 2 layer HASL service asks 0.2 mm tracks, a 0.2 mm via ring, a 0.3 mm plated-hole ring and 0.25 mm from unplated holes to copper (https://community.aisler.net/t/2-layer-simple-design-rules/3735, read 2026-11-24); NextPCB asks 0.40 mm between pads with holes (https://www.nextpcb.com/pcb-capabilities, read 2026-11-24), which no rule here expresses. Choose your fabricator's own profile before ordering: its limits can be looser or stricter than these.

title: Standard · min fiducials per assembled side
summary: JLCPCB Help Center, "How to Add Edge Rails and Fiducials for PCB Assembly Orders" (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/how-to-add-edge-rails-fiducials-for-pcb-assembly-order, last updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-21): "Edge rails and fiducials are required for standard PCB assembly at JLCPCB." and "Three to four fiducial markers should be placed along the board edges to ensure optimal placement accuracy." Per side: "For a double-sided SMT assembly, you must have a set of global fiducials on both the top and bottom sides of the board." (JLCPCB blog, "Fiducial Marks in PCB and SMT Assembly" (https://jlcpcb.com/blog/fiducial-marks, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-21)). PCBWay asks as many (https://pcbway.com/helpcenter/design_instruction/PCB_Panelization__Breakaway_Rails__Fiducial_Marks__Tooling_Holes.html, read 2026-11-21): "there should be at least three fiducial marks arranged in an L shape". Checked on each side that carries surface-mount parts; boards no fabricator assembles need none.

title: Standard · fiducials not symmetric
summary: JLCPCB blog, "Fiducial Marks in PCB and SMT Assembly" (https://jlcpcb.com/blog/fiducial-marks, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-21): "They should be placed in an "L" configuration" and, for round boards, "in a non-symmetrical, non-linear "L" pattern." PCBWay (the page fiducial_count_min cites): "with the diagonal fiducial marks asymmetrical about the center". Checked as: the side's fiducials may not map onto themselves under a half turn about the board outline's centre.
